methodology.title: The SD40K Pod & Relegation System
methodology.summary: An 8-week season with 5 scheduled games inside tiered pods, featuring automatic promotion/relegation and a single-elimination seasonal finals tournament.

scoring_breakdown.win: Actual Game VP + 1,000 Bonus Battle Points (e.g. 93 VP = 1,093 BP)
scoring_breakdown.draw: Actual Game VP + 500 Bonus Battle Points
scoring_breakdown.loss: Actual Game VP + 0 Bonus Battle Points (e.g. 51 VP = 51 BP)
scoring_breakdown.in_pod_ringer_win: Actual Game VP + 750 Bonus Battle Points

faction_rules.lock_policy: Locked for the entire 8-week season. Must field at least 1,001 points of chosen primary faction in every match.
faction_rules.list_policy: Flexible lists between rounds. Detachments, units, and enhancements can be adjusted between games.

promotion_relegation_rules.promotion: Top 2 finishers in Pods 2–7 earn promotion (+1 or +2 pods)
promotion_relegation_rules.relegation: Bottom 2 finishers in Pods 1–6 face relegation (-1 or -2 pods)
promotion_relegation_rules.finals_qualification: Top Pod 1 competitors qualify for the prestigious 16-player Single Elimination Finals Championship

methodology.chess_clock_policy: Mandatory in Pods 1–3 & Finals if requested by either player 24 hours prior. Pods 4–7 require mutual agreement. 2 hours per player.
tiebreakers: 1. Total Battle Points (inclusive of win bonuses)
3. Fastest player to complete all 5 matches
